title: Symbol-U Canonical Concern Ontology
description: Frozen, versioned ontology of canonical human concerns. LLM concern-extraction may ONLY select entries from this set; it may never invent concern names. This schema defines the shape; the populated ontology is a separate versioned data artifact.

ontology_sha256.description: hash of the concerns array, sorted by id

inclusion_criteria.description: conditions under which a conversation counts as this concern

exclusion_criteria.description: conditions that rule it out / distinguish it from sibling concerns

parent.description: parent concern id, or null for a root

synonyms.description: surface phrasings that map to this concern (aids extraction, not authoritative)
